snippet.title: Garfield Kart 2 – All You Can Drift – Trailer
snippet.description:
Monday blues? NOT TODAY! Garfield's trading naps for nitro on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch & PC! September 10th - it's about to get FAST & FURRRRIOUS with Garfield Kart 2 - All You Can Drift!

Play as one of the 8 cult characters from the Garfield universe, prepare your karts, customize your look and launch into frantic races.

Immerse yourself in a wacky universe where every turn holds a surprise. Pirate, western or detective: Garfield travels through colorful worlds to prove that even in his dreams, he's king!

Use shortcuts or bonus items to change the course of the races, and create unforgettable moments with your friends in local or online multiplayer mode.

Ready to race against a real heavyweight?

🐈 Add Garfield Kart 2 to your wishlist :
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239650/Garfield_Kart_2__All_You_Can_Drift/
- PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012444
- Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/garfield_kart_2_all_you_can_drift/9N5PQKL2VJTR
- Epic Games Store : https://store.epicgames.com/p/garfield-kart-2-528e02
